ColonyCouncil.MoodHintDef.fix: Cook more than one kind of meal: bills for two or three kinds, or pemmican, berries or a fine meal in the mix. It eases as the meals change. A colony that can make only one kind feels it least; ascetics and anyone whose faith allows only one kind of food don't mind.
ColonyCouncil.MoodHintDef.keep: Keep three or more kinds of food in the mix, a couple of days at a time.

ColonyCouncil.MoodHintDef.fix: Give them a second kind of work in the Work tab, even a few hours a day. One varied day ends the run. Industrious and hard-working colonists, and anyone with a burning passion for the work, don't mind.
ColonyCouncil.MoodHintDef.act: Add a second kind of work

ColonyCouncil.MoodHintDef.fix: It ends when they're together again. Keep trips short, or send the two of them together.
A bigger room, more seats at the tables, or meals and recreation spread over the day in the schedule. It fades half a day after the crush. Parties and meetings don't count.
Finish the frames that are waiting (often for materials), or cancel what you don't need. Lazy colonists and slobs don't care.
